insufficient: Insufficient balance. Lower your base bet.
locked: Connected purchases are locked pending validation.
jurisdictionUnavailable: Bonus Buy is unavailable in your jurisdiction.
sessionFailed: The Stake session could not be authenticated.
replayError: The replay could not be loaded.
normalWild: Normal expanding Wilds. New Wild reels remain for the feature.
guaranteedWild: An expanding Wild reel is guaranteed on the first Free Spin.
enhancedWild: A starting Wild of at least {n}× is guaranteed on the first Free Spin.
autoLimit: Up to 10 spins at {bet} each. Maximum total bet: {maximum}.
autoStop: You can stop autoplay at any time. A spin already in progress will finish.
confirmPurchase: Confirm the full purchase cost to enter the bonus.
rulesBoard: 5 reels, 5 rows, 20 fixed paylines. Matching symbols pay from the leftmost reel. All lines are included in the bet.
rulesWild: 3 Scatters award 10 Free Spins, with no retriggers. Wilds substitute for paying symbols and expand across their reel. During Free Spins, Wild reels and their multipliers stay in place. Line multipliers add once per reel. An all-Wild line pays the Keeper.
rulesBuy: Standard: 10 Free Spins. Super: a guaranteed expanding Wild on the first spin. Mythic: a starting Wild of at least 8× in Bloom or 20× in Blight. A guaranteed Wild does not guarantee a win. A separate confirmation shows the full purchase cost. Connected purchases remain locked pending validation and jurisdiction approval.
rulesCap: Maximum total return: 5,000× the base bet, including all Free Spins. At the cap, wins are credited in payline order and the feature ends.
rulesWorlds: Bloom offers more frequent, smaller features. Blight offers rarer features and a wider range of payouts.
devInfo: Finite development math, not certified production math. Demo fixtures showcase features; they do not sample these probabilities.
rulesCost: RTP and volatility use the full purchase cost. Payouts use the base bet. The 5,000× cap includes all 10 Free Spins and can end the feature early.
turboInfo: Turbo shortens the animation. Outcomes and winnings stay the same.
